7_* knots 2 most ✓ open

Each proven entry is an asymptotic-expansion theorem for the Kashaev invariant, established by the saddle point method together with the Poisson summation formula; the volume conjecture follows because the leading term of the expansion is the hyperbolic volume and the Chern–Simons invariant of the complement. [ohtsuki-yokota-6crossings] treats 6_1, 6_2 and 6_3 in separate sections, each proving their Theorem 1.1 for the knot named, so the three are discharged individually rather than as a family.

6_2 is the canonical ^2H knot closure, so its row is load-bearing for the binding-scale identification rather than illustrative.
